title: Seconds-to-Clock Flowchart
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Clocks and Watches with AI
description: Step a number of seconds since midnight through a six-box flowchart that uses whole-number division and remainders to produce an hours:minutes:seconds clock reading.

educational.topic: Algorithmic thinking: converting seconds since midnight to hours, minutes, and seconds
learningObjectives: Apply the seconds-to-clock algorithm by tracing a number of seconds through each step.
Use whole-number division (//) and remainder (%) to split a total into larger and smaller units.
Predict the output of each step before running it, and check the prediction.
prerequisites: Knowing that an hour has 3,600 seconds and a minute has 60 seconds.

accessibility.notes: Screen-reader description provided; all controls are standard HTML elements.

controls.label: Seconds since midnight
controls.description: The number to trace through the algorithm.

controls.label: Next step
controls.description: Runs one box, shows its value, and highlights it.

controls.label: Reset
controls.description: Clears all values and returns to step 0.

controls.label: Flowchart boxes
controls.description: Clicking a box shows a one-sentence explanation of that step.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Worked example with prediction at each step
keyQuestions: Why do we compute the remainder before computing minutes?
What happens to the hours box if the input is less than 3,600?
Why is 86,399 the largest allowed input?
commonMisconceptions: Dividing the total seconds by 60 to get minutes, which gives total minutes (754) instead of minutes past the hour (34).
Forgetting to pad single digits, so 9:05:07 is shown as 9:5:7.
Confusing // (whole-number division) with / (division that keeps the decimal part).
assessmentOpportunities: Students can trace any input from 0 to 86,399 to the correct hh:mm:ss reading without the MicroSim.
Students can explain why the remainder step is needed before computing minutes.
Students can convert a clock reading back into seconds since midnight.
